entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Pradhumn Kumar Pandey,Anoop Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dilip Kumar Singh Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned counsel for the opposite party learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No.887 of 2017, under sections 147, 420, 406, 323, 504, 506, 452, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Sardhana, District Meerut, during the pendency of trial.
It is submitted that in this case applicant is a lady and mother of co-accused Arshad.

Further submitted that the applicant alongwith other members of her family lives separately from her son,
therefore, she has no concern with the present dispute.
Neither she prepared any receipt nor tried to grab the property of the informant.

As per the allegation in F.I.R. the house constructed by the informant was given to the family of the present applicant to live for some time but thereafter on Shamshida @ Shammo vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185571083/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: asking for vacation the applicant and other members of her family refused to vacate the house and prepared a receipt on 25.07.2016 for grabbing the property regarding which present F.I.R. was lodged.
It is further submitted that applicant is aged about 60 years and is suffering with old age infirmity.
There is nothing on record to show that she also participated in preparing the forged receipt which is in dispute in this case.
Now after investigation charge sheet has also been submitted against the present applicant also and in pursuance of process of the court the applicant is under apprehension of imminent arrest.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, she would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial.

Learned counsel for the opposite party as well as learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail and urged that the present applicant is mother of co-accused Arshad who prepared the receipt and was got verified in the F.S.L. in which it was found that the handwriting was of co-accused Arshad.

In this way, being mother of co-accused she also participated in the present case, therefore,
she is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of record, the applicant being lady aged about 60 years and without making any comment on the merit of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case during the pendency of trial.

In the event of arrest of the applicant- Shamshida @ Shammo, shall be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the learned court everyday when case is fixed unless exempted;
In default of any of the conditions, this order will automatically stand vacated.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Ashok Gupta  Shamshida @ Shammo vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185571083/
